##### Project general facts

Azizi Pearl is a contemporary residential development in Al Furjan, thoughtfully designed to offer a harmonious balance between modern urban living and lush natural surroundings. Rising seven storeys, the project features a collection of stylish studios, one-, and two-bedroom apartments, all created with an emphasis on comfort, functionality, and refined design. Surrounded by beautifully landscaped parks, cycling tracks, jogging trails, and abundant greenery, Azizi Pearl provides a peaceful residential environment where nature becomes an integral part of everyday life.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle enriched by the vibrant community of Al Furjan, where extensive green spaces, recreational areas, schools, shopping, and excellent connectivity create exceptional everyday convenience. With more than thirty parks woven throughout the neighborhood and easy access to major destinations across Dubai, the development offers the perfect balance between tranquility and accessibility, making it an ideal address for those seeking a connected yet relaxed way of life.

Inside, the residences are designed to maximize natural light and a sense of openness through floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of the surrounding community. Elegant interiors feature fine marble flooring, carefully crafted wall and ceiling details, generous work surfaces, and a warm, earthy color palette inspired by European design traditions. Kitchens come equipped with modern appliances, while buyers can choose between furnished and unfurnished residences, offering the flexibility to create a home that perfectly suits their personal lifestyle.

##### Location description and benefits 

Al Furjan is a residential community situated in close proximity to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR), and other popular areas in Dubai. It covers an area of approximately 560 hectares and consists of both villas and apartment buildings, offering a diverse range of housing options for residents.

The community is known for its well-planned infrastructure and thoughtfully designed properties. It features a mix of architectural styles, including Arabic, Mediterranean, and contemporary designs, creating a visually appealing and diverse atmosphere.

In terms of amenities, Al Furjan offers a range of facilities to enhance the quality of life for its residents. These include landscaped parks, playgrounds, fitness centers, swimming pools, sports courts, and cycling and jogging tracks. There are also retail centers within the community that provide convenient access to shopping, dining, and other essential services.
